For a quadratic \(h(x)=\frac12x^TAx\),

\[
P_{h,\rho}(v)=\rho(A+\rho I)^{-1}v.
\]

Put

\[
a=\lambda\mu,\qquad b=\frac{4\lambda}{\mu},
\qquad
p=\frac{\rho}{\rho+a},\qquad q=\frac{\rho}{\rho+b}.
\]

Then

\[
P_{f,\rho}=\begin{bmatrix}p&0\\0&q\end{bmatrix}=:F,
\qquad
P_{g,\rho}=UFU^T=:G.
\]

Thus the relaxed DR map is linear:

\[
z^+=T_{\rho,\theta}(a,b)z,\qquad
T_{\rho,\theta}=I+\theta\{G(2F-I)-F\}.
\]

Write \(\theta=2t\), \(0<t\le1\), and define the reflected resolvent eigenvalues

\[
r_a=\frac{\rho-a}{\rho+a},\qquad r_b=\frac{\rho-b}{\rho+b}.
\]

Since \(2F-I=\operatorname{diag}(r_a,r_b)\) and \(2G-I=U\operatorname{diag}(r_a,r_b)U^T\),

\[
T_{\rho,2t}=(1-t)I+t\left(U\operatorname{diag}(r_a,r_b)U^T\right)\operatorname{diag}(r_a,r_b).
\]

The worst case is minimized at the full relaxation \(t=1\), i.e. \(\theta=2\). For \(\theta=2\),

\[
T_{\rho,2}
=
\left(U\operatorname{diag}(r_a,r_b)U^T\right)\operatorname{diag}(r_a,r_b).
\]

Let \(R=r_a^2,\ S=r_b^2\). Then

\[
T_{\rho,2}^TT_{\rho,2}
=
\operatorname{diag}(r_a,r_b)\,
U\operatorname{diag}(R,S)U^T\,
\operatorname{diag}(r_a,r_b),
\]

so the squared contraction factor is

\[
\kappa_{\lambda,\mu}(\rho,2)^2
=
\frac14\left((R+S)^2+
\sqrt{(R+S)^4-16R^2S^2}\right).
\]

This is increasing in both \(R,S\). Since \(a,b\in[1/2,8]\), the minimax choice of \(\rho\) balances the endpoint reflected magnitudes:

\[
\left|\frac{\rho-\frac12}{\rho+\frac12}\right|
=
\left|\frac{\rho-8}{\rho+8}\right|.
\]

Solving gives

\[
\rho_*=2.
\]

At \(\rho=2\),

\[
\left|\frac{2-c}{2+c}\right|\le \frac35
\qquad(c\in[1/2,8]),
\]

with equality only at \(c=1/2\) or \(c=8\). The worst cases also require the other curvature to equal \(2\), so that its reflected eigenvalue is \(0\). Hence

\[
R=\frac{9}{25},\qquad S=0,
\]

and therefore

\[
\mathcal C_*^2=\frac12\left(\frac{9}{25}\right)^2
=\frac{81}{1250},
\qquad
\mathcal C_*=\frac{9\sqrt2}{50}.
\]

The equality cases are exactly

\[
(\lambda,\mu)\in
\left\{
\left(\frac12,1\right),
\left(\frac12,4\right),
(2,1),
(2,4)
\right\}.
\]

Therefore

\[
\boxed{
(\rho_*,\theta_*,\mathcal C_*,\mathcal W_*)
=
\left(
2,\,
2,\,
\frac{9\sqrt2}{50},\,
\left\{
\left(\frac12,1\right),
\left(\frac12,4\right),
(2,1),
(2,4)
\right\}
\right).
}
\]
